course_name_original: Métodos Computacionais para a Engenharia Eletrotécnica

learning_outcomes.text: Identify, analyze and solve a presented problem using the most appropriate computational tools.
Use MATLAB software to solve problems, either through built-in tools, already available with MATLAB, or through the implementation of algorithms and / or scripts.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Computational Methods and its importance in Electrical Engineering.
Introduction to MATLAB. MATLAB fundamentals. Matrices and vectors. Matrix operations. Element-wise operations. Solving systems of linear equations.
Scripts and user defined functions.. Anonymous functions.
Symbolic toolbox. Solving of equations and systems of equations. Integration and differentiation.
Roots of algebraic and transcendental equations. fzero and root MATLAB functions.
Numerical integration. Integral, integral2 and integral3 MATLAB functions.
Numerical Integration of Ordinary Differential Equations (ODE). MATLAB functions for numerically solving ODE.
bibliography: Morais, V.; Vieira, C. (2006) - Matlab 7 & 6 Curso Completo, FCA
Quarteroni, Alfio (2007) - Cálculo científico com MATLAB e Octave, Springer
Bober, W.; Stevens, A (2013) - Numerical and Analytical Methods with MATLAB for Electrical Engineers, CRC Press.
Esfandiari, R. (2017) - Numerical Methods for Engineers and Scientists using MATLAB, 2ed, CRC Press.
degree: Licenciatura em Engenharia Eletrotécnica e de Computadores (LEEC)
